node.statement: Banach-valued Newton-Leibniz estimate: if q:[0,1]->X is C^1 and ||q'(t)||<=M, then q(1)-q(0) is the norm-limit of the derivative Riemann sums (equivalently the Bochner/Riemann integral of q'), so ||q(1)-q(0)||<=integral_0^1 ||q'(t)||dt<=M. Applying this with M=c||d|| and observing q(1)-q(0)=F(x_1)-F(x_2)-d proves the secant-error estimate.
